Contact

Contact us

This is an independent editorial directory — not Centrelink. If you need to contact Services Australia, Centrelink, or Medicare for help with your payments, claims, or appointments, use the official channels below.

For Centrelink, Medicare, or Services Australia

  • Centrelink (general): 13 24 68
  • Medicare: 13 20 11
  • Calling from overseas: +61 13 24 68
  • Online: my.gov.au
  • Find your local office: servicesaustralia.gov.au/find-us
  • In person: Find a Service Centre near you
  • Free interpreter: 131 450 (Translating and Interpreting Service)

This directory cannot help with your Centrelink case, claim, payment, or appointment. We have no access to your records or any way to act on your behalf.

About this site

For corrections, data update requests, or feedback specifically about this directory (this website, not Centrelink itself):

  • Email: contact@centrelinkofficesaustralia.com
  • Found a centre that has moved, closed, or has incorrect details? Please let us know which centre and what changed.
  • Services Australia representatives: we welcome official correction requests.

What this directory is

Centrelink Offices Australia is an independent editorial directory built from the public Department of Human Services Centrelink Office Locations dataset. We are not affiliated with Services Australia, Centrelink, Medicare, or the Australian Government. See About this directory for full details.
